name: Teslascope
description: Hooks into Teslascope over MCP and fields queries about your cars — trips taken, charging history, Supercharger stops. Requires an existing Teslascope account with data in it; this is a reporting layer, not something that controls the vehicle.

official.title: Teslascope by Tyler
official.description: A Teslascope assistant for Tesla owners. It connects to Teslascope MCP, then answers questions about drives, Superchargers, charging, and your vehicles.
